strings.notes: US 0715/0; 小雪 → Krise (US contact Picnicker Krise, digest 小雪 → Krise)

strings.zh: 你是不是对我很有兴趣呢？{SCROLL}那我们来交换一下{NEWLINE}电话号码吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: You’re interested in me, aren’t you?{SCROLL}So how about we{NEWLINE}exchange phone numbers?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 欢迎你随时打电话找我。
strings.en: Don’t worry, you can call me anytime!

strings.zh: 是吗⋯⋯{NEWLINE}看来是我想太多了。
strings.en: Oh, I see...{NEWLINE}Maybe I was overthinking things...

strings.zh: 你果然对我很有兴趣吧！{SCROLL}那我们来交换一下{NEWLINE}电话号码吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: I knew it! You are interested in me!{SCROLL}So how about we{NEWLINE}exchange phone numbers?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 你好害羞啊,{NEWLINE}都跑这附近来了,{CLEAR}也不敢来直接来找我。
strings.en: You’re so shy! You came all the{NEWLINE}way over here, but you don’t{CLEAR}dare come talk to me in person.

strings.zh: 我的{VAR:0100:10}很努力的。{SCROLL}你最喜欢什么样的精灵呢？{CLEAR}下次带来给我看看吧。
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10} works really hard.{SCROLL}What kind of Pokémon do you like{NEWLINE}best? Bring it to show me next time.

strings.zh: 听我说！昨天我和{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}打上了,{SCROLL}结果我错失了使用伤药的时机,{CLEAR}差点要被翻盘了,{CLEAR}还好我的精灵们非常努力,{CLEAR}最后险胜而归,{SCROLL}真是太刺激了！
strings.en: Listen! Yesterday I got into{NEWLINE}a battle with a {VAR:0100:11}.{SCROLL}I missed my chance to use a{NEWLINE}Potion, and it nearly turned the{CLEAR}tables on us. But my Pokémon tried{CLEAR}so hard, and we just barely won.{SCROLL}It was such a thrill!

strings.zh: 你收集的精灵们{NEWLINE}都存放在箱子里吗？{SCROLL}我一般都会放他们走。{SCROLL}对了,前不久让{VAR:0100:11}给逃走了。{SCROLL}那实在是太可惜了。
strings.en: Do you keep all the Pokémon you capture{NEWLINE}in PC Boxes?{SCROLL}Me, I usually just let them go...{SCROLL}Oh, right, a {VAR:0100:11} got away from{NEWLINE}me the other day.{SCROLL}What a shame that was.

strings.zh: 喂喂,是不是差不多{NEWLINE}想和我来场对战了？{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你！{NEWLINE}一定要来啊！
strings.en: Hey, don’t you feel like{NEWLINE}battling me about now?{SCROLL}I’m waiting at {VAR:0104:3}!{NEWLINE}You’d better come!

strings.zh: 喂喂,{NEWLINE}你还记得我的约定吗？{SCROLL}我们要在{VAR:0104:3}进行对战的,{CLEAR}你快来啊。
strings.en: Hello? Do you remember our promise?{SCROLL}We’re supposed to battle{NEWLINE}at {VAR:0104:3}.{CLEAR}Hurry up and get here.

strings.zh: 穿着迷你裙去公园{NEWLINE}真是失败的选择。{SCROLL}因为那些草会把我的脚割伤的。
strings.en: It wasn’t a very smart move to come to{NEWLINE}the Park in a miniskirt, was it...?{SCROLL}I mean, these leaves keep scratching{NEWLINE}my legs...
